requirement: Automotive SPICE 4.1 SWE.4.BP1 (specify the software unit verification measures): the unit measures of the software requirements.

measures.title: Data rights functions over test doubles of every store
measures.technique: Jest unit tests of the data rights element with each store reached through a test double of its adapter contract (database, document store, identity provider, audit records, host logs, message service) and an injected clock; requirements-based cases per function and negative cases per refusal.
measures.passCriteria: Passes when: the locator reports, per store, presence and categories for a seeded person and nothing for an unknown one; the copy holds every located item as JSON or CSV; the recipient list equals the recorded disclosures and the sub-processors and holds no other; a rectification is written to every store holding the item and no other copy remains; an erasure leaves no item that identifies the person except those of the keep-list, each with its obligation; the restriction mark is held with its date and returned to the decision; the lifting is refused without the recorded notice; the portable export validates against its published schema and holds only the data the person provided; the direct transmission sends the same content to the named endpoint; a request from another channel stays held until the confirmation is recorded; the notice is sent with the first communication or at the latest one month after the data were recorded; the retention run removes or anonymises exactly the records older than their category's period; a tenant export imported into an empty double reproduces every entity, relation and document; the tenant erasure is refused before the retrieval period has expired without the customer's decision and afterwards leaves only the keep-list items. At d5080b5 nothing can run: the element does not exist.
measures.entry: The data rights element exists with its store adapter contracts; the agreed values (retention periods Q-095 and Q-114, keep-list Q-033) set for the cases that use them.
measures.how: To write: the test suite dataRightsService of the reference server. At the repository root: run the unit suite dataRightsService of the reference server
measures.regression: on change of the data rights element or of a store adapter

measures.title: First recycler's report of every facility
measures.technique: Unit test of the report service with an in-memory data-access double holding the received values of two facilities over two periods.
measures.passCriteria: Passes when: SwR-BACKEND-205: The report for a first recycler lists, for the requested period, one row per facility of the received values, each with its recycling efficiency and its recovery of materials as received; a request for a period without received values is answered 404. Any other observation fails the requirement concerned.
measures.entry: The commit under review is checked out; no database is needed (the unit partition's test environment).
measures.how: the test suite firstRecyclerReport of the reference server (to write, unit partition). At the repository root: run the unit suite firstRecyclerReport of the reference server
measures.regression: on change of EL-BACKEND; and every review
measures.existingEvidence: None: the reference server of this repository is not built yet.
